title: Normalize customer directory records
summary: Convert customer signup records into a clean, sorted public-facing directory.
requirements: Each customer has an integer id, firstName, lastName, email, and active boolean.
Trim name fields; displayName is trimmed firstName + space + trimmed lastName.
Normalize email with trim() and lowercase; preserve all records, including inactive ones.
Return objects { id, displayName, email, active } sorted by numeric id ascending.
Throw an Error containing "Invalid customer" for an unsafe integer id, empty trimmed name part, or email missing @ after trimming.
Throw an Error containing "Duplicate id" if any id is repeated.
Do not mutate the original records.
hints: Validate and normalize each record in one pass.
Use a Set to detect repeated IDs before sorting.
Map to the output shape, then sort with a numeric comparator.
